component.name: RomP
component.summary: Play retro games from your RomM library

description.p: RomP plays the games in your RomM library, with each game running in its own sandboxed process.

ul.li: Your RomM library: platforms, favorites, collections and recently played, with search and box art
One click to play: RomP installs the right emulator and BIOS files, and downloaded games play offline
Saves that follow you: in-game saves and save states sync with RomM before and after you play
Sandboxed emulators: each game runs in a locked-down process that can only write to its own saves
RetroAchievements, with popups, leaderboards and achievement lists
Controllers and multiplayer, with any key or button remappable
